description: Delete 1 to 20 drafts atomically in one call, cleaning up files no other draft uses. Ask the user first. Refused with 409 (and nothing deleted) if any draft still has a queued or unconfirmed delivery.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

ids.description: One to 20 unique draft ids from drafts_list or drafts_search to delete atomically.

name: drafts_delete_batch
title: Delete a batch of drafts
